root_causes_ranked_by_severity.root_cause: EV/EBITDA write-path in normalize_symbol() line ~1409 stores FMP's evToEBITDATTM directly without a positive gate. FMP returns negative values when EBITDA<0. 137 affected rows.
PS Ratio write-path via _map_ratio('priceToSalesRatioTTM','PS Ratio') stores FMP value directly without positive gate. 15 affected rows including AREC=-167M.
EPS Growth source is income-statement-growth.growthEPSDiluted which measures sequential quarter-over-quarter change, not year-over-year. Frontend label 'EPS Growth' implies YoY. 333 affected rows.
FCF Yield has no bounds gate. freeCashFlowYieldTTM*100 stored directly. 5 rows with abs(value)>100%.

All Forward multiples (Forward P/E, P/S, EV/Sales, EV/EBITDA) and trailing multiples via profile-derived market cap use FMP profile price at weekly refresh time. Price drift between refreshes (observed: AMD 6.3%, AAPL 0.8%) creates stale valuation ratios. Architectural — not fixable without live price injection at serve time.
ROIC sourced from FMP returnOnInvestedCapitalTTM without independent NOPAT/IC verification. Provider-direct, cannot audit formula.

canonical_formula_contract.PE_Ratio: marketCap / TTM_net_income; store only if > 0; otherwise N/M
canonical_formula_contract.PS_Ratio: marketCap / TTM_revenue; store only if > 0; otherwise N/M (must add gate)
canonical_formula_contract.EV_EBITDA: FMP_enterpriseValueTTM / TTM_EBITDA; store only if > 0; otherwise N/M (must add gate)
canonical_formula_contract.Forward_PE: price_at_refresh / FY1_annual_EPS_consensus; positive FY1 EPS required
canonical_formula_contract.Forward_EV_EBITDA: FMP_EV / FY1_EBITDA_consensus; store only if > 0 (gate working)
canonical_formula_contract.PFCF: marketCap / TTM_FCF; store only if > 0 (gate working)
canonical_formula_contract.FCF_Yield: TTM_FCF / marketCap * 100; propose gate: abs(result) <= 100 or negative FCF → N/M
canonical_formula_contract.EPS_Growth: MUST be YoY: (latest_Q_diluted_EPS / same_Q_prior_year_diluted_EPS - 1) * 100 using fiscal match; current implementation is sequential QoQ — misleading label
canonical_formula_contract.Net_Debt_EBITDA: totalDebt - cash / TTM_EBITDA; negative = net cash, acceptable
canonical_formula_contract.ROIC: Provider-direct (FMP). Independent formula: NOPAT / avg_invested_capital — not feasible with current field set
canonical_formula_contract.Cash_Runway: Cash / |TTM_FCF| * 12; only when FCF < 0; self_funding when FCF >= 0
canonical_formula_contract.Revenue_Acceleration: (latest_Q_YoY_rev_growth - prev_Q_YoY_rev_growth) in percentage points; fiscal exact match required
canonical_formula_contract.Incremental_Operating_Margin: delta_TTM_op_income / delta_TTM_revenue * 100; gate: delta_rev > $50M AND > 1% of prior TTM rev

source_of_truth_hierarchy.price: FMP profile.price at weekly refresh — STALE between refreshes. Drift up to ~6% observed (AMD). Forward P/E, Forward P/S drift proportionally.
source_of_truth_hierarchy.market_cap: FMP profile.marketCap at weekly refresh. All valuation ratios using market cap are stale between refreshes.
source_of_truth_hierarchy.shares: Implied from mktcap/price (profile). Latest diluted shares from IS for share-count computations.
source_of_truth_hierarchy.statements: FMP quarterly IS (8Q), CF (5Q), BS (2Q). Strict TTM requires 4 distinct-date quarters.
source_of_truth_hierarchy.enterprise_value: FMP key-metrics-ttm.enterpriseValueTTM — includes minority interest and preferred equity. Simplified EV (mktcap+debt-cash) diverges for financial companies (JPM indep=-4.95x vs FMP=20.39x). Always use FMP EV, never simplified for display.
source_of_truth_hierarchy.estimates: FMP analyst-estimates annual. FY1 = first estimate date strictly after completed FY end date (fiscal-period-aware, not calendar-year anchored).
source_of_truth_hierarchy.currencies: USD assumed for all US-listed symbols. Foreign-listed symbols not in current universe (FMP profile.currency checked). No ADR pairs detected in audit sample.
source_of_truth_hierarchy.fiscal_periods: _identify_completed_fiscal_year() reads fiscalYear+period from IS rows. Non-calendar FY companies (e.g. IREN FY ends Jun 30) correctly handled via fiscal anchor, not calendar date.
